note: The blind annotation of the causal-route experiment. Committed with the predictions, before any reviewer saw anything. Reviewers are shown only the 'intention', 'reasons' and questions of each item, in the order and orientation the protocol gives them. They are never shown this file, the rule ids, the route keys, the answer key, the experiment's hypotheses or each other's answers.

reasons.says: Putting yourself in the way of something, which takes somebody to put yourself in front of.
draws_on: how much they value keeping the family safe

reasons.says: Shielding somebody from a thing they are not in the room for.
Nobody pulls rank in an empty room. What makes it authority rather than housekeeping is that somebody is there to see it.
draws_on: whether they believe they lead the family

reasons.says: Settling a thing because settling things is yours to do. It needs no audience, and it rises when you are already angry.
draws_on: whether they believe they lead the family

reasons.says: The plainest reading of one's own act: a job that needed doing.
draws_on: how much they value keeping the family safe

reasons.says: Proving it to yourself rather than to them, which only makes sense where nobody is watching.
Defusing: not making a scene of it. A dominant person does not defuse, they settle it.
draws_on: how dominant they are, which counts against this

reasons.says: Choosing not to have it out, with nobody there to have it out with yet.
draws_on: how anxious a person they are

reasons.says: I take it on myself to keep them from harm: looking after them is my job.
Keeping them out of harm's way is my responsibility, so I do it.

reasons.says: I take it on myself to keep them from harm: looking after them is my job.
I cannot bear to see them suffer, so I put myself between them and it.
I do it quietly, so that nobody knows I was the one who cared.
I do it openly, so that everyone sees I can be relied on.
I protect them because I feel their fear as if it were mine.
Feeling their fear so strongly freezes me, and I hold back.
draws_on: how empathetic the person is, which here counts against protecting
